description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Blue River Technology develops intelligent machinery and robotics for agriculture and related industries. The Embedded Software Engineer will develop and maintain embedded software and systems for computer vision-enabled agricultural products, focusing on cameras, sensors, device drivers, and hardware-in-the-loop continuous integration.
Embedded Software Engineer building Linux/Yocto applications, kernels, camera/sensor drivers and image-quality features, plus hardware-in-the-loop CI regression tests

Responsibilities:
• Develop, enhance, and debug new and existing software applications, kernels, and device drivers for impactful robotics computing in C/C++ and Rust within a Linux environment
• Enhance camera and sensor capabilities, image quality, and exposure configuration; support training data collection operations
• Ensure OS (Yocto) support is implemented properly for sensors
• Build automated driver and camera regression tests that run in continuous integration on hardware-in-the-loop platforms
• Conduct embedded design reviews and code reviews, providing guidance to resolve difficult driver bugs which may require extensive troubleshooting
• Implement embedded design best practices and methodologies to ensure high performance and reliability, with a strong emphasis on real-time programming considerations

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
• 1-3 years of experience developing embedded software
• Familiarity with cameras/other sensors and camera interfaces (e.g., MIPI CSI-2)
• Strong attention to detail with a focus on testing and continuous integration practices
• Knowledge of real-time systems and performance optimization techniques

Preferred:
• Camera and camera interface testing, including performance testing under physical conditions such as shock/vibe, EMI, and temperature
• Expertise in Linux kernel device driver development and tuning real-time applications for low latency
• Experience in development on ARM platforms (NVIDIA Jetson) and Linux (Yocto, meta-tegra) embedded systems
• V4L2 camera driver expertise
• Experience with NVIDIA driver development
• Experience building or maintaining continuous integration pipelines for embedded software
• Middleware experience, particularly with pub/sub architectures
